column1: # ncz-screensaver-strength.tsv - saver GPU class -> how the screensavers behave
# text = one plain-English phrase, appended to the GPU line of the installer
# This table words an expectation; it does not classify anything and no
# installer decision reads it. A class with no row words nothing (the GPU
# line is still printed). ASCII only: the d-i C locale renders anything else
#    weak    the cheap tier: the engine renders every saver at the reduced
#            scale (measured >= 20 ms per frame on this class)
#    mid     the middle band: full frame rate on the simpler saver set
#    strong  discrete-class: every saver at full quality, no calibration down

column2: the simple saver set at a reduced scale
